metadata.datasource: Generated with spektrafilm_profile_builder 0.1.0 from digitised data-sheet curves. KODAK technical data E-55 (June 2009), e55.pdf, PDF page(s) 3, KODAK KODACHROME 25 Professional [PKM]: https://125px.com/docs/film/kodak/e55.pdf Estimate placeholders (not on the sheet): dye densities outside the printed range (held below, exponential decay above), sensitivity tails below the printed log -2 and beyond the printed wavelengths, interlayer DIR scale (film_render_overrides).
